title: 車輪在軌鏇削設備~Underfloor wheel-lathe systems
focus: 輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測~Geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining
summary: 本課聚焦輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測。從輪徑與切削線速度建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把加工設備穩態熱路與輪廓量測誤差合成連成可驗證的介面，最後以輪型與缺陷案例矩陣整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining. Start with wheel diameter and cutting speed to define physical or information boundaries, connect steady heat paths in machining equipment with combining profile-measurement uncertainty as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through wheel-type and defect case matrix. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2015 年品質管理方法的二零一五版發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用徑向去除與壽命帳及加工後驗證完整工時連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2015: The twenty-fifteen edition of quality-management requirements was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through radial removal and life accounting and complete post-machining verification effort. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪徑與切削線速度。原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。公式 y=pi*D*rpm，代入得 y=158.336 m/min。邊界：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。敏感度只改 D=0.84 至 0.924 m，輸出變為 174.17 m/min；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究徑向去除與壽命帳：原創假想教學輸入：原始輪徑 D0=840 mm；單側徑向去除 depth=1.5 mm。公式 y=D0-2*depth，代入得 y=837 mm。邊界：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel diameter and cutting speed. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Formula y=pi*D*rpm gives y=158.336 m/min. Boundary: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings. For sensitivity, change only D=0.84 to 0.924 m; the output becomes 174.17 m/min. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate radial removal and life accounting: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial diameter D0=840 mm; radial removal per side depth=1.5 mm. Formula y=D0-2*depth gives y=837 mm. Boundary: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 輪徑與切削線速度~Wheel diameter and cutting speed
units.title: 輪徑與切削線速度~Wheel diameter and cutting speed
units.mechanism: 本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。切削線速度由輪徑與轉速共同決定，相同轉速在不同直徑會造成不同刀具接觸條件。輪對鏇削還要考慮夾持剛度、材料硬點和輪廓基準；把工具轉速設定正確，並不能保證完成後輪廓與同軸度符合需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。~Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Cutting surface speed depends on diameter and rotational speed, so the same rotation rate produces different tool conditions on different wheels. Reprofiling also depends on clamping stiffness, hard spots and profile reference. Correct speed setting does not by itself establish final profile or concentricity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。公式 y=pi*D*rpm，代入得 y=158.336 m/min。邊界：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Formula y=pi*D*rpm gives y=158.336 m/min. Boundary: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings.
units.verify: 以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。以「輪徑與切削線速度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately. For wheel diameter and cutting speed, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 以標稱輪徑代替磨耗後直徑會錯估速度，輪面滑動則使驅動滾輪轉速不再代表輪對轉速。回到「輪徑與切削線速度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Nominal instead of worn diameter biases speed; roller slip makes drive-roller rotation differ from wheelset rotation. Trace the input chain for wheel diameter and cutting speed. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 輪徑改變時固定轉速仍會維持相同切削線速度~Fixed rotational speed maintains the same cutting speed when wheel diameter changes.
units.practice: 只把輪徑 D 從 0.84 改成 0.924 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 158.336 變為 174.17 m/min。先說明「輪徑與切削線速度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only wheel diameter D from 0.84 to 0.924 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 158.336 to 174.17 m/min. Explain the causal direction for wheel diameter and cutting speed, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 徑向去除與壽命帳~Radial removal and life accounting
units.title: 徑向去除與壽命帳~Radial removal and life accounting
units.mechanism: 本單元把單側切深換算成直徑耗用，將每次修整量保留在輪對履歷以檢查剩餘材料。徑向切深在直徑上會出現兩倍的減少，輪徑耗用應與可維修壽命一起追蹤。修掉一處缺陷所需的最小去除量可能決定整個輪對的加工深度；只追求表面光滑而忽略剩餘輪緣與直徑，可能提早耗盡零件壽命。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。~Convert radial cut depth to diameter consumption, retaining each reprofiling removal in wheelset history to track remaining material. Radial removal reduces diameter by twice the cut depth, so diameter consumption belongs in life tracking. The removal needed for one defect may govern the entire wheelset. Optimizing surface appearance while ignoring remaining flange and diameter can consume useful life prematurely. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：原始輪徑 D0=840 mm；單側徑向去除 depth=1.5 mm。公式 y=D0-2*depth，代入得 y=837 mm。邊界：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial diameter D0=840 mm; radial removal per side depth=1.5 mm. Formula y=D0-2*depth gives y=837 mm. Boundary: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified.
units.verify: 用獨立量具比對加工前後直徑，將每次去除量累積到輪對履歷並核對輪廓基準。以「徑向去除與壽命帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare before/after diameters with an independent gauge and accumulate removal in wheelset history while checking profile datums. For radial removal and life accounting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把徑向去除誤當直徑去除會少算一倍耗用量，量具零點偏差又可能讓兩側輪徑差被隱藏。回到「徑向去除與壽命帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Confusing radial and diametral removal understates consumption by a factor of two; gauge zero error can hide a side-to-side difference. Trace the input chain for radial removal and life accounting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 切去一毫米徑向材料時輪徑也只會減少一毫米~Removing one millimetre radially reduces diameter by only one millimetre.
units.practice: 只把單側徑向去除 depth 從 1.5 改成 1.65 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 837 變為 836.7 mm。先說明「徑向去除與壽命帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only radial removal per side depth from 1.5 to 1.65 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 837 to 836.7 mm. Explain the causal direction for radial removal and life accounting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 切屑體積與節拍~Chip volume and processing cycle
units.title: 切屑體積與節拍~Chip volume and processing cycle
units.mechanism: 本單元以矩形切屑類比計算去除率，另外計入檢測與重工時間以免只追求刀具接觸時間最短。體積去除率由截面乘相對進給估算，能用來連結節拍、切屑與能量需求。增加去除率會同時提高熱與力的負擔，實際效果受刀具、材料與剛度限制；縮短加工時間若造成重工，總維修週期反而可能增加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：矩形切屑截面的概念估算，非輪廓加工刀路與實際參數建議。~Use a rectangular-chip analogy to estimate removal rate and separately include inspection and rework rather than minimizing tool-contact time alone. Volumetric removal rate is cross-sectional area times relative feed, linking cycle time, chips and energy demand. Higher removal increases thermal and mechanical loading, limited by tooling, material and stiffness. A shorter cut can lengthen the total maintenance cycle when it creates rework. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual rectangular chip section, not an actual reprofiling tool path or production setting.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：加工寬度 width=6 mm；切入厚度 depth=0.4 mm；相對進給速度 feed=100 mm/s。公式 y=width*depth*feed，代入得 y=240 mm3/s。邊界：矩形切屑截面的概念估算，非輪廓加工刀路與實際參數建議。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: cutting width width=6 mm; cut thickness depth=0.4 mm; relative feed speed feed=100 mm/s. Formula y=width*depth*feed gives y=240 mm3/s. Boundary: Conceptual rectangular chip section, not an actual reprofiling tool path or production setting.
units.verify: 比較去除前後體積與切屑收集量，將停頓、量測與重工時間納入完整節拍。以「切屑體積與節拍」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare removed volume with collected chips and include pauses, measurements and rework in total cycle time. For chip volume and processing cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只記刀具接觸時間會低估設備占用，刀具磨耗造成去除率下降也可能被程序時間掩蓋。回到「切屑體積與節拍」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Recording only tool-contact time understates equipment occupation; tool wear can reduce removal rate without appearing in nominal program duration. Trace the input chain for chip volume and processing cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 切削速度提高就能保證整個維修週期必定縮短~Increasing cutting speed guarantees a shorter overall maintenance cycle.
units.practice: 只把相對進給速度 feed 從 100 改成 110 mm/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 240 變為 264 mm3/s。先說明「切屑體積與節拍」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only relative feed speed feed from 100 to 110 mm/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 240 to 264 mm3/s. Explain the causal direction for chip volume and processing cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 加工設備穩態熱路~Steady heat paths in machining equipment
units.title: 加工設備穩態熱路~Steady heat paths in machining equipment
units.mechanism: 本單元以等效持續熱源觀察冷卻路徑，區分機體穩態溫升與刀尖短時高溫不能由同一模型代表。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Observe cooling paths under equivalent sustained heating, distinguishing machine steady temperature from transient tool-tip heat that this model cannot represent. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.verify: 同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。以「加工設備穩態熱路」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes. For steady heat paths in machining equipment, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。回到「加工設備穩態熱路」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima. Trace the input chain for steady heat paths in machining equipment. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱~A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
units.practice: 只把等效熱阻 Rth 從 0.035 改成 0.0385 K/W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 61.5 變為 64.65 degC。先說明「加工設備穩態熱路」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only equivalent thermal resistance Rth from 0.035 to 0.0385 K/W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 61.5 to 64.65 degC. Explain the causal direction for steady heat paths in machining equipment, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 加工激振與結構頻率~Machining excitation and structural frequency
units.title: 加工激振與結構頻率~Machining excitation and structural frequency
units.mechanism: 本單元用單自由度模型比較支承剛度與等效質量，指出自然頻率接近激振並不直接給出振幅。單自由度固有頻率由剛度與質量比的平方根決定。提高剛度可能移開一個激振頻率，也可能移近另一個頻率；阻尼控制峰值而不只改變頻率，因此僅比較靜態變形不能預測動態放大。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。~Use a single-degree model to compare support stiffness and effective mass, noting that proximity to excitation frequency does not directly determine amplitude. A single-degree natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. Stiffening can move away from one excitation yet toward another. Damping controls the resonant peak as well as frequency effects, so static deflection alone cannot predict dynamic amplification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：等效剛度 k=1.8e+06 N/m；等效質量 m=12000 kg。公式 y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)，代入得 y=1.94924 Hz。邊界：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent stiffness k=1.8e+06 N/m; equivalent mass m=12000 kg. Formula y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi) gives y=1.94924 Hz. Boundary: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.
units.verify: 用低能量掃頻或自由衰減試驗量頻率與阻尼，對照載重改變後的模態移動。以「加工激振與結構頻率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure frequency and damping with low-energy sweep or free decay, then compare modal shifts after changing load. For machining excitation and structural frequency, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. units.anchor: 刀具磨耗與輪廓~Tool wear and profile quality
units.title: 刀具磨耗與輪廓~Tool wear and profile quality

units.anchor: 輪廓量測誤差合成~Combining profile-measurement uncertainty
units.title: 輪廓量測誤差合成~Combining profile-measurement uncertainty
units.mechanism: 本單元分離輪廓掃描重複性與夾持基準偏差，避免把同一基準的相關誤差當成獨立來源。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。~Separate profile-scanner repeatability from clamping-datum bias, avoiding treatment of errors sharing one reference as independent sources. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.

units.anchor: 輪面缺陷取樣間距~Sampling intervals for wheel defects

units.anchor: 加工後驗證完整工時~Complete post-machining verification effort
units.title: 加工後驗證完整工時~Complete post-machining verification effort

units.anchor: 輪型與缺陷案例矩陣~Wheel-type and defect case matrix
